Animalism.name: Untamed
Animalism.description: Failing to Ride the Wave during Frenzy inflicts two Stains. Convictions cannot mitigate these Stains.

Auspex.name: Daymares
Auspex.description: When awakening for the night, make two Rouse Checks instead of the usual one.

Blood Sorcery.name: Sanguinary Animism
Blood Sorcery.description: For any scene following a feeding, the vampire loses two dice from all Social and Mental pools due to distraction.

Celerity.name: Breakdown
Celerity.description: Whenever the vampire fails a Rouse Check when activating a Celerity power, they sustain 1 point of Aggravated Health damage.

Dominate.name: Blunt
Dominate.description: Vampires with this Flaw cannot spend Willpower to reroll a Social test.

Fortitude.name: Scar Tissue
Fortitude.description: When rousing the Blood to restore Health, the physical appearance of injuries sustained remains until resting for the day.

Obfuscate.name: Faded
Obfuscate.description: When making Remorse tests, the vampire rolls one fewer die (the one die minimum still applies).

Oblivion.name: Monstrous
Oblivion.description: Treat Humanity rating as three lower for Blush of Life, Social pools, and physical appearance. If this takes rating below one, gain the Repulsive Flaw.

Potence.name: Killer Instinct
Potence.description: If failing a Rouse Check when activating a Potence power, immediately test for Fury Frenzy as if physically provoked.

Presence.name: Egomaniac
Presence.description: Whenever a Presence power generates a messy critical or fails to sway a target, make a Fury Frenzy test at Difficulty 2.

Protean.name: Stasis
Protean.description: If failing a Rouse Check while activating a Protean power, reverting leaves an incomplete change.
